items.title: If You Ran Revvity, What Would You Fix?
items.summary: If you own Revvity, the last five years have been hard to watch. The shares returned -18.5% in that time, counting dividends. The S&P 500 returned 64.5%. A 50.3% gain over the past year has not closed that gap.

items.title: Should Illumina Stock Holders Look At Thermo Fisher Instead?
items.summary: Illumina and Thermo Fisher Scientific both sell the tools labs use to study biology and find new drugs. They part ways on focus. Illumina is built around gene sequencing machines and their supplies. Thermo Fisher sells to many kinds of labs, with $47.4 billion of yearly revenue against Illumina's $4.5 billion.

items.title: Cathie Wood Just Bought $10 Million of Twist Bioscience Across 2 ARK Funds
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCathie Wood’s ARK Invest bought 97,284 shares of Twist Bioscience on Friday across two ETFs, worth about $10 million at Friday’s close. Twist trades 53% below its 52-week high, but it just guided to 21% revenue growth for fiscal 2027, in line with what analysts expect.

items.title: Illumina (ILMN) Stock May Be A Bargain Despite Singapore Genome Win
items.summary: Illumina has seen its stock swing sharply in recent years, and with cash flows sitting at the center of the story, the question now is whether the current price lines up with what the business is likely to generate over time. Over the past 3 years, Illumina has delivered a 111.2% share price gain. This puts a lot of weight on whether the underlying cash flows can support that kind of re-rating. items.title: Illumina (ILMN) Wins The 2026 Virtual Cell Challenge
items.summary: Illumina (NasdaqGS:ILMN) said its BioInsight AI Lab won the 2026 Virtual Cell Challenge with its CellularAI platform. The competition recognized CellularAI for using AI to predict cellular behavior from large scale biological datasets. Organizers highlighted the potential of CellularAI to support future drug discovery workflows and biomedical research programs.
